points.label: Strong-man sequence
points.left: Healing prompts a charge, Jesus names Satan, kingdom division, God’s Spirit, the strong man, gathering, and contested speech.
points.right: Jesus casts out a mute demon, and the man speaks. Some marvel, while others test Jesus or accuse him of working through Beelzebul. Jesus answers with Satan’s divided kingdom, God’s finger, the strong man, and gathering.

payload.posture: Read both WEBU passages side by side. Keep each passage’s actors, setting, order, and identity claims distinct.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus contrasts the charge with casting out by God’s finger

payload.tension: Both disputes describe Satan’s divided kingdom. Their wording and nearby sayings differ.
payload.title: The divided satanic kingdom in Matthew and Luke
